scope: Only the three R117A copper strokes; no blanket power/GND exception, full-board qualification, or physical validation
observations: B-side bridge is straight and supply branch has one 45-degree bend; no new B-side component-body crossing.
Existing parts, core header/connector positions, holes, outline, layer rules and critical local loops are unchanged.
Only the two listed opposite-F-face body projections are new outside existing lands; both have continuous adjacent In4 ground.

exceptions.reason: One-bend B-side branch between the existing HEAD_VM resistor lands, preserving C1201 input-capacitor placement and its front-side power loop. Moving the bend later in R117C shorted an existing ground via; rotations did not shorten the terminal separation. Continuous In4 ground covers the exposed stroke. Only this small opposite-face C1201 projection is accepted; power transient and temperature remain untested.

Short direct B-side bridge between adjacent dump resistor lands. Both resistor terminals keep their outward side; no via, component, switching loop, or rule changes. Nearby rotation and translation alternatives were screened; R117B/C caused explicit clearance/courtyard violations. Continuous In4 ground covers the exposed stroke. This opposite-face L901 projection is bounded to this track and does not qualify coupling or thermal behaviour.

comparison_limits: Rotation/courtyard/pad screening is read-only, not 95 fully rerouted native candidates. R117B/C are saved and independently native-DRC-checked rejected candidates. Alternatives are not proven globally impossible.
qualification: Only local visual inspection with two explicitly documented development exceptions
